articles.title: These hot S&P 500 stocks show where investors are heading as they run away from tech
articles.summary: The industrials sector has been a big beneficiary of the rotation out of tech, with a number of defense and transportation stocks hitting new highs on Wednesday.

articles.title: I’m 59, earning six figures, but my daughter wants me to retire to watch my future grandkid for a year. Can I afford it?
articles.summary: “I do have a decent 401(k) and also should be able to benefit from my husband’s Social Security.”

articles.title: Here are the new release dates for January’s jobs and CPI inflation reports
articles.summary: The U.S. employment report for January originally due on Friday has been rescheduled for the middle of next week — and the consumer price index was also pushed back a couple of days.

articles.title: The Social Security data breach is a national-security disaster that could hurt Americans for the rest of their lives: whistleblower
articles.summary: Every American’s personal data is at risk of fraud after DOGE’s alleged mismanagement, Social Security’s former chief data officer tells MarketWatch.

articles.title: Lilly says Mounjaro and Zepbound sales more than doubled as stock rallies
articles.summary: Late last year, Lilly was the first pharmaceutical stock to reach a $1 trillion valuation.

articles.title: This company is providing relief from higher utility rates, and the stock is surging
articles.summary: Enphase’s stock was soaring Wednesday after the company’s upbeat earnings report and a view that residential solar demand has bottomed as consumers look for relief from higher electricity costs.

articles.title: Uber’s stock falls as record demand for rides fails to deliver the profit investors expected
articles.summary: Uber’s stock dropped toward a 10-month low Wednesday as a quarterly profit miss offset record user results.

articles.title: The economy got off to a decent start in the new year. Businesses hope things get even better.
articles.summary: The largest part of the  economy expanded again in January and pointed to decent growth early in the new year, as businesses grapple with the lingering effects of highs tariffs and how to adopt artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Why AMD’s stock is diving toward its worst day in years after earnings
articles.summary: AMD’s beat wasn’t as strong as it seemed, and high operating expenditures also clouded a strong report.

articles.title: Gold’s back over $5,000 and silver’s surging as well
articles.summary: Gold futures reclaimed the $5,000 level on Wednesday, and silver led the charge higher in precious metals with a more than 7% rise — with both metals extending their recovery from a recent, historic decline into a second session.
